description.en: Apple, Google, and Tesla emerge from flowing vertical lines, with spring motion and pointer-driven detection boxes.
description.zh: 竖线重构 Apple、Google 与 Tesla 标志，结合弹簧回弹及随鼠标变化的检测框连线。

keywords: 品牌 线条 卡片 竖线 苹果 谷歌 特斯拉 检测框 连线 识别 噪声 弹簧 logo brand apple google tesla canvas luminance detection spring

discovery.caveat: 演示含第三方品牌标志，接入时替换为项目自己的素材。

instructions.en: Move across each card to scatter the lines and change detection boxes. Tap on touch screens, or focus a card with the keyboard. Reveal the source opens its SVG path.
instructions.zh: 在卡片上移动鼠标，体验线条散开回弹与检测框变化；触屏可点击，键盘可聚焦卡片。点击 Reveal the source 查看 SVG 路径。
